pack.name: Automotive manufacturing reference
pack.description: Advisory automotive manufacturing guidance layered over stable Composer process, capability and integration semantics.

evidence.title: Automotive reference architecture method
evidence.note: Internal reference guidance for architecture review; it is not presented as an industry standard or customer-specific fact.

guidance.statement: Sequence-sensitive manufacturing should make ordering, execution acknowledgements and failure recovery explicit across production handoffs.
When production and warehouse execution are separate responsibilities, inventory and completion handoffs should be reviewed as an explicit architecture boundary.
